messages.text:
Garage, yes. Outdoors, no — it's a desktop tower with open vents, not weather-sealed, so rain, humidity and dust will kill it.

In a garage it's fine if it stays dry and above freezing-ish and you give it airflow; it's ~50 dB in Eco and pushes ~650W of heat at 40 TH/s, so a garage is honestly the better spot than a living room.

Is the garage insulated or does it get damp?
how much does it cost to run on average electric price

About 470 kWh a month running flat out at 40 TH/s (~650W, 24/7). At a US average near 17 cents that's roughly $80 a month; in Eco at 30 TH/s it drops to about $55.

Tell me your state and I'll run the real numbers for your rate — sats stacked, power cost and the break-even BTC price.

North Carolina power runs roughly 12–13 cents a kWh, so about $57 a month at 40 TH/s, closer to $40 in Eco at 30 TH/s.

At that rate home mining is about stacking sats and the solo-block shot, not net profit at today's BTC price — I won't pretend otherwise. The 40T is our best value per terahash though, $799 and $16/TH.

Is the garage on its own circuit, or sharing with the big stuff?
